sentences: A regular language of infinite trees defines an event under a random tree-generating process.
This project asks whether its probability measure can be computed for general tree automata, extending the source's result for weak automata.
General acceptance allows alternation between least and greatest fixed points, bringing more complicated limiting behavior.
The corresponding logical target includes full monadic second-order logic and the modal mu-calculus.
A general algorithm would enable exact probabilistic analysis of branching specifications whose recurring obligations exceed the weak acceptance fragment.
